```python
import polars as pl

# Create sample long-format data
df_long = pl.DataFrame({
    "date": ["2026-07-01", "2026-07-01", "2026-07-01", 
             "2026-07-02", "2026-07-02", "2026-07-02"],
    "city": ["New York", "Los Angeles", "Chicago",
             "New York", "Los Angeles", "Chicago"],
    "temperature": [22.5, 28.3, 19.7, 23.1, 29.5, 20.2]
})

print("Long format:")
print(df_long)

# Reshape to wide format
df_wide = df_long.pivot(
    on="city",
    index="date",
    values="temperature"
)

print("\nWide format:")
print(df_wide)
```
